claims.statement: mise.toml is the single toolchain file: it pins node, pnpm, uv, lefthook, sfw, fastchess, Stockfish and the langsmith CLI, while Python comes from uv rather than mise.

The setup task installs Python and web dependencies through Socket Firewall (sfw uv sync --all-packages --all-groups, sfw pnpm install --frozen-lockfile) and then installs git hooks with lefthook install.

dev:web refuses to start if LANGGRAPH_PORT (default 2024) or WEB_PORT (default 5173) answers on 127.0.0.1 or ::1, then runs langgraph dev on LANGGRAPH_PORT and Vite on WEB_PORT (--strictPort, VITE_API_URL pointing at the langgraph port) in the background, each in its own process group via set -m, plus an announcer that prints the UI/API/Studio URLs once the API's /ok and Vite's root URL respond or fails after 2 minutes.

Commands that make model calls or LangSmith writes load .env explicitly via uv run --env-file .env (dev:tui, dev:uci, test:live, test:uci with ../.env, review:snapshot, probe:efforts, eval:positions:upload, eval:systemone, eval:systemone:baseline), while langgraph dev reads .env through the env key in langgraph.json.

test:python passes -n auto on the command line rather than in pytest addopts so a bare pytest stays serial; pytest addopts deselect the live and e2e markers and enforce 100% coverage with branch coverage, and test:live runs -m live --no-cov with .env loaded.

The .env template derives LANGSMITH_GATEWAY_API_KEY and TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the shell's LC_GATEWAY_KEY; if it is missing they expand to empty, so ServerSettings rejects set-but-blank gateway/TypeSafe values to prevent a silent fallback to the tracing key.

mise.toml defines no build task; the web UI is built with vp build into apps/web/dist by default, and the Vite config's base and output directory come from BASE_PATH (default /) and OUT_DIR, which the GitHub Pages workflow and the e2e test override.

The lefthook pre-commit hook runs in parallel, gated by staged file globs (vp check for ts/tsx/css/json, ruff format check and ruff lint on staged Python files, ty check), plus a per-file secret-pattern scan of added staged lines that prints only matching file names; pre-push runs mise run test.
Dependencies are added through sfw (sfw uv add --package, sfw uv add --group dev, sfw pnpm add in the consuming JS package).

OpenWiki is pinned per wiki task (npm:openwiki 0.9.0 on wiki:init, wiki:update and wiki:view) rather than in [tools] because CI's mise install skips task tools; the three task pins and the workflow's sfw-guarded install pin (also 0.9.0) must be bumped together.

scripts/openwiki.sh sources .env if present, routes OpenWiki model calls to Anthropic via the LangSmith LLM Gateway using LC_GATEWAY_KEY, maps LANGSMITH_API_KEY to OPENWIKI_LANGSMITH_API_KEY, traces to the langchain-chess-openwiki project after unsetting LANGSMITH_AGENT_ID and LANGSMITH_AGENT_ENVIRONMENT, disables telemetry, and fails fast if either key is missing.

The openwiki-update workflow runs on manual dispatch and a weekly Monday schedule, is serialized by a concurrency group, skips the update job while an openwiki/update PR is open, uses a full-history checkout, installs OpenWiki via sfw, runs mise run wiki:update with continue-on-error, opens a docs: update OpenWiki PR on branch openwiki/update when files changed, and fails the job afterward if OpenWiki failed.

scripts/setup-worktree.sh re-trusts and installs mise tools per worktree, symlinks the main checkout's .env without replacing a worktree's own .env, then runs mise run setup; t3.json runs it on worktree creation.

test:uci runs a two-game fastchess smoke match inside .uci-match/ between two System 1-only lcchess uci --policy systemone instances (seeds 1 and 2) and fails unless both games have a result and every Termination tag is normal or adjudication.

The wiki:init task runs scripts/openwiki.sh with --init and then restores openwiki/.langsmith.json via git checkout, because --init keeps only INSTRUCTIONS.md and drops the committed connector config.

dev:web polls its jobs every 0.5s (no wait -n on macOS bash 3.2); the first server to exit, or an announcer failure, ends the task with that exit status, and an EXIT trap kills every remaining process group.
The review app run by dev:review uses the langsmith CLI's own credentials rather than .env, so it needs a one-time langsmith auth login --prompt-workspace.
check:python runs ruff format --check, ruff check and ty check over the repo root (ty's sources are libs, apps/server and evals), and check:web runs pnpm exec vp check.

test:e2e runs pytest -m e2e --no-cov without a separate build step; the browser test runs langgraph dev with a throwaway .env and an environment stripped of LANGSMITH_, LANGCHAIN_, TYPESAFE_ and LC_ variables, then builds the web UI itself with VITE_API_URL pointed at that server and OUT_DIR set to a temp dir, serving it from another origin as GitHub Pages does and failing if the build fails.

generate:settings runs langchain_chess_server.codegen to write the settings JSON Schemas and TypeScript into packages/chess-ui/src/generated, and test_codegen fails when the committed generated files differ from the rendered output.

The eval tasks wrap the lcchess-evals CLI: eval:positions:build samples and labels Lichess positions into evals/datasets/positions/vN.jsonl, eval:positions:upload pushes that JSONL to a LangSmith dataset tagged vN, eval:systemone runs one System 1 experiment, and eval:systemone:baseline runs the four experiments in evals/experiments/systemone-baseline.toml (Jev rich and terse, Luna rich, and a Jev control capped at 16 options).
review:snapshot runs scripts/grader-snapshot.py with .env loaded to build the review app's langchain-chess-grader snapshot in a LangSmith sandbox from docker/grader.Dockerfile and workspace wheels.

Local tracing targets the langchain-chess agent's local environment through LANGSMITH_AGENT_ID and LANGSMITH_AGENT_ENVIRONMENT; LANGSMITH_PROJECT must not also be set because with both the SDK traces nothing.

The agent:tag task runs scripts/agent-tags.sh, which uses the langsmith CLI API to tag the langchain-chess-positions dataset (and thereby its experiments) and each of the langchain-chess agent environments' tracing projects with the agent's tag; it skips the dataset with a hint to run eval:positions:upload when it does not exist yet, and CI runs it after every deploy.
probe:efforts makes real model calls via python -m langchain_chess.efforts to record which model specs accept a reasoning effort, re-probing every recorded spec plus any given after --.
lcchess grade locates games by agent environment (--environment, defaulting to LANGSMITH_AGENT_ENVIRONMENT, local vs production), with --project overriding it.

ServerSettings reads OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and ALLOWED_ORGANIZATION_ID from the shell then .env, trimming them and treating blank as unset (unlike the gateway/TypeSafe keys, where blank is an error); unset, the server refuses sign-in tokens while API keys still work.

Local Sign in with LangSmith needs VITE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID, VITE_LANGSMITH_ORGANIZATION_ID and optionally VITE_LANGSMITH_SSO_SLUG in apps/web/.env.development.local plus OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and ALLOWED_ORGANIZATION_ID in .env; langgraph dev lets keyless requests through, so the sign-in screen only appears against a server that requires it.

The web app's langsmithAppConfig offers only API keys when VITE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID is empty, and reports a configuration problem when the client id is set without VITE_LANGSMITH_ORGANIZATION_ID; values are trimmed.
